title: When the Inheritance Wakes Again
author: Lena Coldharbour
blurb: Astrid Sandoval, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
